privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal information, contact {{company}} at {{email}}.
privacy.description: How we handle your data, and the privacy-first principles behind AURA.
privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {{company}} ("{{company}}", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and shares information when you use the AURA applications, websites, and related services (collectively, the "Service"). AURA is built to be privacy-first: wherever possible, your data stays on your own devices and is never used to train models.
privacy.label: LEGAL

body: This Policy applies to information we process when you use the Service. It does not apply to third-party services, AI models, or integrations that you choose to connect, which are governed by their own privacy policies.
sections.heading: 1. Scope

body: Account information, such as your name, email address, and authentication details when you create an account.
Usage and device information, such as app version, device type, and diagnostic and performance data used to operate and improve the Service.
Content you provide, including prompts, instructions, files, and other User Content you submit. Where the architecture allows, this content is processed locally on your device.
Payment information. If you purchase a subscription, our payment processors collect billing details. We do not store full payment card numbers.
sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect

body: We use information to provide, maintain, and secure the Service; to authenticate you and manage your account; to process payments; to provide support; to detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, and security issues; and to comply with legal obligations.
We use diagnostic and usage data to understand how the Service performs and to improve it.
sections.heading: 3. How We Use Information

body: AURA is designed so that your personal and corporate data stays under your control. Agents run in isolated environments, and wherever possible your User Content is processed on your own devices rather than sent to our servers.
sections.heading: 4. Local-First and On-Device Processing

body: When you use features that rely on AI models, the necessary inputs may be sent to the relevant model provider to generate Output. We do not use your personal or corporate User Content to train models, and we design the Service so that data sent to frontier models is minimized and, where feasible, de-identified.
Third-party model providers process data under their own terms and privacy policies.
sections.heading: 5. AI Models and Data Handling

body: We do not sell your personal information. We share information only as follows: with service providers who process data on our behalf under confidentiality obligations; with third-party services and models you choose to connect; to comply with law or valid legal process; to protect the rights, safety, and security of users, the public, or {{company}}; and in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, subject to this Policy.
sections.heading: 6. How We Share Information

body: We retain personal information for as long as needed to provide the Service and for legitimate business or legal purposes. We delete or anonymize information when it is no longer needed, subject to applicable law.
sections.heading: 7. Data Retention

body: We use technical and organizational measures, including encryption and isolated execution environments, to protect information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
sections.heading: 8. Security

body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or port your personal information, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent. Residents of the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and California, among others, may have additional rights under laws such as the GDPR and the CCPA/CPRA.
To exercise these rights, contact us at {{email}}. We will respond as required by applicable law, and we will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.
sections.heading: 9. Your Rights and Choices

body: We may process and store information in countries other than the one in which you reside. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers of personal information.
sections.heading: 10. International Data Transfers

body: The Service is not directed to children under the age required by applicable law, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us personal information, contact us at {{email}} and we will take appropriate steps to delete it.
sections.heading: 11. Children's Privacy

body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will update the effective date above and, where required, provide additional notice. Your continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
sections.heading: 12. Changes to this Policy
